# Deployment Diagram — ERP API Token Manager

```mermaid
graph TD
    subgraph Internet["Internet Zone"]
        Browser["Browser\n(ERP IT Admin / Business User)"]
        N8NExternal["N8N Workflow\n(External Automation Client)"]
    end

    subgraph DMZ["DMZ / Ingress Zone"]
        NGINX["NGINX Ingress Controller\nerp-nginx-ingress:latest\nKubernetes DaemonSet\nTLS :443 (SSL Certificate)\nTerminates HTTPS → HTTP :8080"]
    end

    subgraph PrivateSubnet["Private Subnet / App Zone"]
        subgraph AppDeployment["Kubernetes Deployment: erp-api-token-manager (HA: Min Replicas ≥ 2)"]
            AppPod1["App Pod 1\nerp-api-token-manager:latest\nCPU: 0.5 cores\nMemory: 512Mi\nPort: 8080"]
            AppPod2["App Pod 2\nerp-api-token-manager:latest\nCPU: 0.5 cores\nMemory: 512Mi\nPort: 8080"]
            AppPodN["App Pod N (HPA)\nmin=2, max=5 pods\nScale by CPU > 70%"]
        end
        HPA["HorizontalPodAutoscaler\nmin=2 / max=5\ntarget CPU: 70%\n(EDD §3.6 HA Min Replicas ≥ 2)"]
    end

    subgraph DataZone["Data Zone"]
        subgraph PGStatefulSet["Kubernetes StatefulSet: postgresql"]
            PGPod["PostgreSQL 16\npostgres:16-alpine\nPort: 5432\nschema: erp_token\nCPU: 1 core / Memory: 1Gi"]
            PVC["PersistentVolumeClaim\nStorage: 20Gi\nStorageClass: standard"]
        end
        PGPod --> PVC

        subgraph RedisDeployment["Kubernetes Deployment: redis"]
            RedisPod["Redis 7\nredis:7-alpine\nPort: 6379\nIdempotency cache (24h TTL)"]
        end
    end

    subgraph ObsZone["Observability Zone"]
        OtelCollectorDeploy["OtelCollector\notel/opentelemetry-collector:latest\nPort: 4317 gRPC (receive traces)\nPort: 8888 HTTP (health)"]
        PrometheusDeploy["Prometheus\nprom/prometheus:latest\nPort: 9090 HTTP\nScrape interval: 15s\nRetention: 15d"]
        GrafanaDeploy["Grafana\ngrafana/grafana:latest\nPort: 3000 HTTP\nPVC: 5Gi (dashboards)"]
        AlertManagerDeploy["AlertManager\nprom/alertmanager:latest\nPort: 9093 HTTP"]
        JaegerDeploy["Jaeger\njaegertracing/all-in-one:latest\nPort: 16686 HTTP (UI)\nPort: 14250 gRPC (receive traces)"]
    end

    %% Internet → DMZ
    Browser -->|"HTTPS :443"| NGINX
    N8NExternal -->|"HTTPS :443\nBearer Token"| NGINX

    %% DMZ → Private
    NGINX -->|"HTTP :8080\n(Round Robin)"| AppPod1
    NGINX -->|"HTTP :8080\n(Round Robin)"| AppPod2
    NGINX -->|"HTTP :8080\n(Round Robin)"| AppPodN
    HPA -.->|"controls"| AppDeployment

    %% App → Data
    AppPod1 -->|"TCP :5432\nEF Core / Npgsql\nschema=erp_token"| PGPod
    AppPod2 -->|"TCP :5432\nEF Core / Npgsql\nschema=erp_token"| PGPod
    AppPodN -->|"TCP :5432\nEF Core / Npgsql\nschema=erp_token"| PGPod
    AppPod1 -->|"TCP :6379\nRESP (Idempotency)"| RedisPod
    AppPod2 -->|"TCP :6379\nRESP (Idempotency)"| RedisPod
    AppPodN -->|"TCP :6379\nRESP (Idempotency)"| RedisPod

    %% App → Observability
    AppPod1 -->|"OTLP gRPC :4317\n(traces)"| OtelCollectorDeploy
    AppPod2 -->|"OTLP gRPC :4317\n(traces)"| OtelCollectorDeploy
    AppPodN -->|"OTLP gRPC :4317\n(traces)"| OtelCollectorDeploy

    %% Observability internal
    OtelCollectorDeploy -->|"gRPC :14250\n(forward traces)"| JaegerDeploy
    PrometheusDeploy -->|"HTTP pull :8080/metrics\n(scrape)"| AppPod1
    PrometheusDeploy -->|"HTTP pull :8080/metrics\n(scrape)"| AppPod2
    PrometheusDeploy -->|"HTTP pull :8080/metrics\n(scrape)"| AppPodN
    GrafanaDeploy -->|"HTTP :9090\n(query)"| PrometheusDeploy
    PrometheusDeploy -->|"HTTP :9093\n(alerts)"| AlertManagerDeploy
```

## Kubernetes Resource Specifications

### App Deployment

| 屬性 | 值 |
|------|-----|
| Image | `erp-api-token-manager:latest` |
| Replicas (HPA min) | **≥ 2**（EDD §3.6 HA — Pod-level redundancy）|
| Replicas (HPA max) | 5 |
| HPA Scale Trigger | CPU > 70% |
| CPU Request | 0.5 cores |
| Memory Request | 512Mi |
| Port | 8080 (HTTP) |
| Health: Liveness | GET /health/live |
| Health: Readiness | GET /health/ready |
| Stateless | App pods 完全 stateless；session/idempotency 外部化至 Redis |
| Graceful Shutdown | 30s drain on SIGTERM（EDD §3.6.5）|

### PostgreSQL StatefulSet

| 屬性 | 值 |
|------|-----|
| Image | `postgres:16-alpine` |
| Port | 5432 |
| Schema | `erp_token`（共用 process / 共用 DB；ApiTokenBC + AuditLogBC，HC-1 cross-BC 不 JOIN）|
| CPU | 1 core |
| Memory | 1Gi |
| PVC Size | 20Gi |
| StorageClass | standard |

### Redis Deployment

| 屬性 | 值 |
|------|-----|
| Image | `redis:7-alpine` |
| Port | 6379 |
| 用途 | Idempotency 快取（24h TTL）— `IIdempotencyKeyStore` 後端 |
| Replicas | 1（MVP；Post-MVP 可升級為 Sentinel HA）|

### Observability Stack

| 元件 | Image | Port | 說明 |
|------|-------|------|------|
| OtelCollector | `otel/opentelemetry-collector:latest` | 4317 gRPC | 接收並轉發 Traces |
| Prometheus | `prom/prometheus:latest` | 9090 HTTP | 指標收集和儲存 |
| Grafana | `grafana/grafana:latest` | 3000 HTTP | 可視化 Dashboard |
| AlertManager | `prom/alertmanager:latest` | 9093 HTTP | 告警路由 |
| Jaeger | `jaegertracing/all-in-one:latest` | 16686 UI, 14250 gRPC | 分散式追蹤 |

## Network Connections

| 來源 | 目標 | 協議:端口 | 說明 |
|------|------|----------|------|
| Browser / N8N | NGINX | HTTPS:443 | 外部流量入口 |
| NGINX | App Pods | HTTP:8080 | 反向代理轉發 |
| App Pods | PostgreSQL | TCP:5432 | EF Core 資料庫存取（schema=erp_token）|
| App Pods | Redis | TCP:6379 | Idempotency 快取（24h TTL）|
| App Pods | OtelCollector | gRPC:4317 | 推送 Traces |
| OtelCollector | Jaeger | gRPC:14250 | 轉發 Traces |
| Prometheus | App Pods | HTTP:8080/metrics | 拉取指標 |
| Grafana | Prometheus | HTTP:9090 | 查詢指標 |
| Prometheus | AlertManager | HTTP:9093 | 推送告警 |

## Network Zones

| Zone | 說明 | 元件 |
|------|------|------|
| Internet Zone | 公共網路，外部用戶和 N8N | Browser, N8N |
| DMZ / Ingress Zone | 流量入口，TLS 終止 | NGINX Ingress Controller |
| Private Subnet / App Zone | 應用運算，不對外直接暴露 | App Pods (HPA managed) |
| Data Zone | 資料儲存，嚴格訪問控制 | PostgreSQL 16 StatefulSet |
| Observability Zone | 監控和可觀測性 | Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger, OtelCollector, AlertManager |
